defs.def: to bring your hand, or an object you are holding, against sb/sth quickly and with force （用手或器具）击，打

ex.s: We yelled at the bear，hit pots hard，and fired blank shotgun shells into the air.
ex.t: 我们朝熊大喊，用力敲打锅，并向空中开了几发空弹。

defs.def: to come against sth/sb with force, especially causing damage or injury 碰撞；撞击（造成损伤）

ex.s: Suddenly football feel just in front of me but almost hit me.
ex.t: 突然一个足球掉在我面前，差点砸到我。

ex.s: In fact, more than one account suggests that while Newton was certainly inspired by a falling apple, there is no proof that it hit him on the head.
ex.t: 事实上，不止一个说法表明，虽然牛顿确实受到一个落下的苹果的启发，但没有证据证明它砸中了他的头。

defs.def: to knock a part of your body against sth 使（身体部位）碰上（某物）

ex.s: According to her research, runners hit the ground with as much as four times their body weight per step, while race walkers, who do not leave the ground, create only about 1.4 times their body weight with each step.
ex.t: 根据她的研究，跑步者每跑一步，落地时承受的冲击力高达其体重的四倍，而竞走运动员由于脚不离地，每步产生的力约为体重的1.4倍。

defs.def: to reach and touch a person or thing suddenly and with force 子弹、炸弹或射击者、抛掷者

ex.s: A flash of lightning hit the kite, and electricity was conducted through the string to the key.
ex.t: 一道闪电击中了风筝，电流通过线传导到了钥匙上。

defs.def: to bring a bat, etc. against a ball and push it away with force 击（球）

ex.s: Summers in the mid-70s were spent at home shooting baskets, hitting a baseball, or throwing a football, preparing for my future as a quarterback on a football team.
ex.t: 70年代中期的夏天都在家里度过：投篮、打棒球或扔橄榄球，为将来成为橄榄球队的四分卫做准备。

ex.s: In my first P.E. class, the teacher required us to run laps and then hit a softball.
ex.t: 在我的第一节体育课上，老师让我们跑圈，然后打垒球。

defs.def: to score points by hitting a ball 击球得分
to have a bad effect on sb/sth 产生不良影响；打击；危害

ex.s: A(n) 6______ hit Iran in February 1972, Causing a week of extremely low temperatures.
ex.t: 1972年2月，一场____袭击了伊朗，造成持续一周的极低气温。

ex.s: A flood had hit the area earlier that year and the   24    it caused had driven away a number of birds.
ex.t: 那年早些时候，一场洪水袭击了这个地区，洪水造成的____赶走了一些鸟类。

ex.s: (Picture) The 8.1-magnitude Earthquake that hit Nepal on 25 April 2015, was one of the worst earthquakes in history.
ex.t: 2015年4月25日袭击尼泊尔的8.1级地震是历史上最严重的地震之一。

ex.s: First, China needs to undergo rapid economic development before a population zxxk decline hits the country.
ex.t: 首先，中国需要在人口下降冲击国家之前实现经济快速发展。

ex.s: Scammers follow money，so companies will be the worst hit.
ex.t: 骗子追逐金钱，所以公司将首当其冲，受到最严重的冲击。

defs.def: to attack sb/sth 攻击；进攻；袭击
to reach a place 到达（某地）

ex.s: Hit the streets with confidence. _____33_____ Say, “Excuse me, I work for XYZ News, and I was wondering if you could share your opinion about this topic.” This is a quick way to get people to warm up to you.
ex.t: 自信地走上街头。_____33_____ 说："打扰一下，我在XYZ新闻工作，我想知道您是否愿意分享对这个话题的看法。" 这是让人们快速对你产生好感的好方法。

ex.s: He knew that zxxk once he hit the hill, he’d be easy caught up and the wolf’s teeth would be tearing into his flesh.
ex.t: 他知道一旦上了坡，他就很容易被追上，狼的牙齿将会撕咬进他的肉里。

ex.s: The man-on-the-street interview is an interview in which a reporter hits the streets with a cameraman to interview people on the sport. _____31_____ But with these tips, your first man-on-the-street interview experience can be easy.
ex.t: 街头采访是一种记者带着摄像师走上街头就某个话题采访路人的方式。_____31_____ 但有了这些建议，你的第一次街头采访经历可以变得轻松愉快。

defs.def: to reach a particular level 达到（某水平）
to experience sth difficult or unpleasant 遇到（困难）；经历（不愉快的事情）

ex.s: All I do is party and hit the books.” _4 “There isn’t really much in my fridge.
ex.t: 我做的就是参加聚会和拼命学习。

ex.s: You’ll hit roadblocks, and you’ll feel discouraged at times.
ex.t: 你会遇到障碍，有时也会感到气馁。

defs.def: to come suddenly into your mind 使突然想起

ex.s: And then, one day I was at a big conference and it suddenly hit me like lightning.
ex.t: 然后，有一天我在一个大型会议上，我突然像被闪电击中一样恍然大悟。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日那天我们收集物品的所有努力终于汇聚在一起．当我看到我们收集的各种物资时我突然意识到我们当天要制作的每一个包裹最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中．在过去四个月里我从没想过项目完成后我会是什么感觉．在制作包裹的过程中我意识到我已经忘记了它背后的真正意义．我只把它当作又一个学校项目而且我想在这个项目上取得好成绩．当包裹完成准备运往海外时那种温暖的感觉是我永远不会忘记的．

ex.s: The realization that this is a precious land, to be respected by humans, was one of the biggest things that hit home to Ginni.
ex.t: 意识到这是一片珍贵的土地，应该受到人类的尊重，这是Ginni感触最深的事情之一。

ex.s: What do the underlined words "hit home for me" mean in paragraph 2?
ex.t: 第2段中带下划线的词组"hit home for me"是什么意思？

ex.s: This hit home for me as I was sitting with my 2-year-old grandson on a sofa over the Spring Festival holiday.
ex.t: 当春节假期我和两岁的孙子坐在沙发上时，这让我深有感触。

defs.def: to press sth such as a button to operate a machine, etc. 按，压（按钮等）
an act of hitting sb/sth with your hand or with an object held in your hand 打；击
an occasion when sth that has been thrown, fired, etc. at an object reaches that object 命中；击中
a person or thing that is very popular 很受欢迎的人（或事物）

ex.s: TOKNOW Magazine is a big hit in the world of children’s publishing, bringing a unique combination of challenging ideas and good fun to young fans every month.
ex.t: TOKNOW杂志在儿童出版界大受欢迎，每月为小读者们带来挑战性思想与乐趣的独特组合。

defs.def: a successful pop song or record 风行一时的流行歌曲（或唱片）
an amount of an illegal drug that is taken at one time 一剂毒品
a violent crime or murder 暴力犯罪；凶杀
a result of a search on a computer, for example on the Internet （在计算机或互联网上搜索的）查询结果
